description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", ranges from 0 to 6 with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 12 to 28 with tick marks at 2-unit intervals. The plot displays four distinct lines: a purple dashed line with circular markers for Consistency-CE, a purple solid line with square markers for Inconsistency-CE, a blue dashed line with square markers for Inconsistency-CE-MP, and a red solid line with star markers for Consistency-Bi. The Consistency-Bi line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 22.5 at AL=0 and increases steadily to about 27.5 at AL=6. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at a BLEU score of approximately 20 at AL=0 and rises to about 27 at AL=6. The Consistency-CE line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 13 at AL=0 and increases to about 26 at AL=6. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line begins at a BLEU score of approximately 20 at AL=0 and increases to about 27 at AL=6. All lines show an increasing trend across the range of AL values shown.
